title: mixelpixx/Konnect: an agent plugin for KiCad board design
friendlyTitle: A plugin that lets an agent work in KiCad
summary: Konnect is the next unpublished AI repo on today's trending lists, with about 230 stars today and 1,300 in total. It is a native KiCad 10 plugin: one Rust program that exposes 217 tools for schematics, placement, routing, design review, and manufacturing files to Claude or another model. The public licence is AGPL-3.0, with a separate commercial option.
friendlySummary: Konnect is the next unpublished AI project on today's trending lists, with about 230 new stars and 1,300 in total. It is a plugin for KiCad 10. One program gives a model 217 tools for circuit drawings, part placement, routing, review, and manufacturing files. The public licence is AGPL-3.0.
whyItMatters: A hardware designer can ask an agent to inspect or edit a board instead of clicking through every KiCad command. Most board tools need KiCad open with that board loaded. The agent can still place a part in the wrong spot, so the board file needs a human review before it goes to a manufacturer.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can ask an agent to inspect or change a circuit board instead of clicking every KiCad command yourself. Most tools need KiCad open with that board loaded. Check the file yourself before you send it to be made.
